summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ) filed an 8-K reporting that IQM Quantum Computers Oy issued a press release announcing IQM's Capital Markets Day Presentation. This is part of RAAQ's ongoing business combination with IQM, announced February 22, 2026. The registration statement was declared effective June 5, 2026, and the definitive proxy/prospectus was mailed to shareholders as of June 3, 2026, with an extraordinary general meeting to approve the transaction. No deal terms (price, premium, consideration) are explicitly stated in the excerpt. Watch the shareholder vote and redemptions; risk-arb focuses on approval and closing timeline.
